en-US.title: I have no appetite and feel lazy, so I'm going to make a simple egg fried rice.
en-US.description:
Simple and Clean Egg Fried Rice

The cooking process is quite easy, so even if you aren't a good cook, you can make a sufficiently delicious egg fried rice.

1. Slice the green onions to your liking.

(It tastes best with plenty of the white parts of the green onions.)

2. Prepare butter or oil, melt it over low heat, and make green onion oil with the green onions.

3. Push the green onions to one side and add the eggs. If you prefer, you can use two eggs.

4. Add the rice on top of the eggs and stir-fry.

5. Season with salt and pepper. If you want a Chinese-style flavor, you can add soy sauce or oyster sauce.

6. Stir-fry until crispy and dry to evaporate the moisture, and it's simply finished! Filming & Production Business Inquiries

I prefer my stir-fried garlic stems to be soft! 1. Remove the tough bottom part and flower buds from the garlic scapes.

2. Wash the sliced ​​garlic scapes under running water about 3 to 4 times.

3. Stir-fry the garlic scapes in a dry pan (you don't need to add oil).

4. Add half a cup of water and stir-fry.

5. Pour in 3 swirls of soy sauce and 1 swirl of oligosaccharide.

6. Stir-fry, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and steam for 5 minutes.

7. Once the garlic scapes have shriveled, sprinkle with a little red chili powder.

8. Turn off the heat and drizzle with sesame oil.

This is my style of stir-fried garlic scapes, and it is a side dish I really love.

It might not look the best, but please give it a try. ^^

en-US.title: Have you tried braised green onion? It's so simple, but it tastes amazing!!
en-US.description:
I had no appetite, so I made it incredibly salty, but you guys, try making it less salty than I did. ^^

1. Cut the green onion jelly into bite-sized pieces.
2. Drizzle with a generous amount of sesame oil (or olive oil) and add soy sauce. *I recommend brewed soy sauce.*
You can use significantly less soy sauce than I did.
3. Once the sauce is boiling, add the green onion jelly and stir twice with the mirin.
4. Once the green onion jelly is cooked and completely translucent, sprinkle with pepper and top with green onions.
5. If you're eating it as a rice bowl, try adding an egg or sesame seeds.

I had no appetite, but this was perfect! The salty, simmered soy sauce flavor really whetted my appetite.

Hot muk is soft, and cold muk has a slightly chewy texture, making it incredibly appealing. ^^/

en-US.title: The zucchini triangle pancake is pretty and delicious!!
en-US.description:
Let's make some pretty zucchini triangle pancakes!!

Let's try making something a little different, but delicious.

1. Slice the zucchini lengthwise thinly with a mandolin and briefly marinate in salt.
2. Drain the tofu and finely chop the shrimp (2 parts shrimp to 1 part tofu).
3. Add the refrigerated vegetables (excluding the onion).
4. Season with salt and pepper, then add the pancake mix and an egg.
(Adjust the ratio to your taste.)
5. Drain the zucchini, fold it into a triangle, and fry.
6. If the zucchini is not seasoned enough, add seasoning.

1 part soy sauce/0.5 part vinegar/0.5 part mirin/1 part Cheongyang pepper or green onion/0.5 part sesame oil/0.5 part sesame seeds

en-US.title: Simple yet delicious soybean paste stew recipe
en-US.description:
Here's a simple yet clean-tasting Doenjang Jjigae recipe.

1. For 600ml of water, add 3 tablespoons of anchovy sauce and 2 tablespoons of doenjang.
*Seasonings may vary depending on the company, so adjust accordingly.

2. Add the potatoes first, as they take longer to cook, followed by the zucchini.
3. Add the green onions, Cheongyang peppers, and tofu 5 minutes before turning off the heat.
4. Adding crab or dried shrimp will create foam, so skim it off for a cleaner flavor.
*If you don't have any, it's still delicious.*
5. The key is to avoid adding minced garlic, gochujang, or red pepper powder!!

en-US.title: This concludes the entire holiday feast of shiitake mushroom pancakes. They're seriously delicious.
en-US.description:
These shiitake mushroom pancakes are seriously delicious...

Based on 600g of pork
1. Wipe the shiitake mushrooms with a paper towel and remove the tails.
2. 1 ladle of soy sauce / 1 ladle of mirin / 1/2 ladle of minced garlic / 1 tablespoon of seasoned salt / lots of pepper
*Shiitake mushroom pancakes taste best with a slightly salty filling, so make them a little salty.
3. Sprinkle a little seasoned salt and pancake mix on the inside of the shiitake mushrooms, then place the filling on top and press it down.
4. For the egg wash, mix 5 eggs with 1 tablespoon of water and 1 teaspoon of salt.
5. Fry the mushrooms so that the meat touches them first and cook over medium-low heat.
6. Do not coat the mushroom caps with egg.
7. Enjoy!!

snippet.title: 장염타파! 닭죽 장염에 좋은 장염 전용 닭죽 먹고 장염 으쌰으쌰 이겨내봐요!!
snippet.description:
장염타파 닭죽 
요즈음 크론병이랑 장염이 유행을 한다고 해요
우리 건강 잘 챙겨야겠죠? 남자친구가 장염이 너무 심해서
끙끙 앓더니.. 기운이 없어서 기운을 차려줄 수 있는 장염 전용 닭죽을
만들어 보았어요!!

장염이나 위염이 없다면 그냥 닭으로 하셔도 됩니다.
장염에는 기름기가 안좋기 때문에 저는 닭안심만 사용 했어요

1.찹쌀은 충분히 불려주세요 (덜 불리면 죽을 만들 때 좀 더 익히면 돼요)
2.삼계탕 육수와 황기 대추를 넣고 안심을 함께 넣고 끓여 주세요
*대파와 마늘은 장염에는 좋지 않아서 조금만 넣어주세요 안넣으셔도 돼요
3.국물 위에 올라온 불순물을 걸러주시고 국물을 깨끗하게 만들어 주세요
4.안심을 건져내고 잘게 찢어주세요 장염이 매우 심하다면 아주 잘게~
5.참기름 아주 살짝 두르고 불려둔 찹쌀을 약 5분간 볶아 줍니다
6.아까 만들어둔 국물을 추가 해 가며 팔팔팔 끓여주세요 
7.국물은 생각보다 많이 필요 합니다 찹쌀의 양 보다 약 10배 이상의 양이 필요해요
8.팔팔팔 끓어 오르면 저어주다가 약불로 줄이고 약 15분 정도 가끔 저어가며 익혀주세요
*이때 찹쌀이 충분히 안불었다면 조리 시간을 늘려주세요
9.닭안심을 넣고 살짝 뒤적거린 후에 불을 끄고 5분동안 뜸을 들입니다
*뜸 들이는 동안 국물이 밥알에 전부 흡수 돼요 국물을 자작하게 남겨주세요
10 맛있고 건강하게 냠냠!!!

en-US.title: Fight off enteritis! Chicken porridge is good for enteritis. Eat chicken porridge specifically fo...
en-US.description:
Chicken Porridge for Enteritis
Crohn's disease and enteritis are on the rise these days. We need to take care of our health, right? My boyfriend was suffering from severe enteritis, and he was feeling down. So, I made chicken porridge specifically for enteritis to help him feel better!

If you don't have enteritis or gastritis, you can just use chicken. I only used chicken breast, as fat is bad for enteritis.

1. Soak the glutinous rice thoroughly (if it's not soaked enough, you can cook it a little longer when making the porridge).
2. Add the samgyetang broth, astragalus root, and jujube, and bring to a boil with the tenderloin.
*Green onions and garlic are not good for enteritis, so add a small amount. You can omit them.
3. Strain the impurities that rise to the top of the broth and make a clear broth.
4. Drain the tenderloin and shred it. If your enteritis is severe, shred it very finely.
5. Drizzle a little sesame oil and stir-fry the soaked glutinous rice for about 5 minutes.
6. Add the broth you made earlier and bring to a boil.
7. You'll need more broth than you think. You'll need about 10 times the amount of glutinous rice.
8. Once it's boiling, stir, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
*If the glutinous rice isn't fully cooked, increase the cooking time.
9. Add the chicken tenderloin. Add the rice, stir briefly, then turn off the heat and let it sit for 5 minutes.
*The rice will absorb the broth while it's steaming. Save the broth for later.
10 Delicious and healthy, yum yum!!!

Spinach soybean paste salad is easy!

A clean, authentic Korean dish!

1. Blanch the spinach in salted water for 30-40 seconds without washing it first.
2. Tear off the spinach leaves individually and rinse them in cold water.
3. Rinse the bowl until no more dirt remains.
*Spinach roots are also rich in nutrients! Don't throw them away! 4. Squeeze out about 80-90% of the water.
5. Gently mix in 1 teaspoon soybean paste, 2 teaspoons sesame oil, 1.5 teaspoons anchovy sauce, plenty of sesame seeds, and 1 teaspoon minced garlic.
*Please note that the seasoning of anchovy sauce may vary depending on the manufacturer.
6. Add the green onions and soybean paste seasoning and mix well. Done!

Slightly squeeze the spinach before eating to get the right flavor later! The water will come out of the spinach.

en-US.description:

Soak the potatoes for about 20 minutes.

Cut the Spam into bite-sized pieces.

Lightly oil the potatoes and sauté the minced garlic. Once fragrant, add the Spam and sauté.

Add the shredded potatoes and, when they're half-cooked and slightly translucent, add 1 teaspoon of tuna sauce.

Season with just a little salt. If the potatoes are overcooked, they will fall apart, so check the seasoning and taste regularly.

en-US.description:
Marinate the chicken in milk with bay leaves for about an hour. You can marinate it longer! However, an hour will sufficiently remove any gamey odor.

Place it in the air fryer with the belly exposed and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.
Flip it over and bake at 180°C for another 25 minutes.

Fry again at the same temperature for 10 minutes on each side.

A whole chicken that's delicious even without any dipping sauce.

정말 맛있게 양념 잘 베게 만드실 수 있어요

en-US.title: If you make stir-fried pork like this, the flavor will really come through and it will be delicio...
en-US.description:
Jeyukbokkeum (stir-fried pork) is the soul food of Koreans!!! Here's how to make Jeyukbokkeum (spicy stir-fried pork):
You'll be able to make it really delicious, with the seasonings penetrating well.

1. Marinate 300 grams of pork with 2 tablespoons of mirin and 2 tablespoons of allulose (sugar).
(This way, the sugar will first contact the pork, widening the pores and allowing the seasonings to penetrate better.)

2. Mix 2 tablespoons of red pepper powder, 5 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of minced garlic, a pinch of ginger, a pinch of pepper, 1 tablespoon of mirin, 5 tablespoons of water, and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.
(Adjust the saltiness of soy sauce as needed, as each brand's saltiness varies.)

3. Add green onions to a little oil to release the green onion oil and stir-fry the meat first.
4. Once the meat is about 90% cooked and turning white, add a little of the seasoning sauce and stir-fry.
5. Instead of adding all of the seasoning all at once, add it little by little to taste.
6. Adding a cup of water at this point will help it cook more evenly and taste better.
7. Add the vegetables and stir-fry last.

en-US.title: Let's make a superfood side dish of chickpea and anchovy stir-fry, the king of calcium.
en-US.description:
After soaking the chickpeas, boil them.
When it starts to boil vigorously over high heat, reduce to low.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

Fry the anchovies until crispy.

Shake off the powder from the anchovies.
(This powder can be used as a natural seasoning later.)

Add 3-5 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of minced garlic. Stir-fry until fragrant, then reduce the heat to low.

Add about 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and about 3 tablespoons of mirin.

When foaming occurs, add the drained chickpeas. Stir-fry briefly, then add the anchovies and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir-fry, turn off the heat, then add the oligosaccharide.
Add sesame seeds, sesame oil, or perilla oil to taste.
